sources.title: NRCS SNOTEL daily snow water equivalent, snow depth and air temperature (AWDB REST API), station annual snowfall derived for the snowfall heat map
sources.note: Public domain (US government work, USDA NRCS National Water and Climate Center). Derived, not measured: SNOTEL measures snow water equivalent and depth, not snowfall. Daily new snow = daily SWE gain / new snow density (the SNOW-17 step HCN = PX / DHN), never below the daily depth gain, with the climate.snotel thresholds (SWE gain 0.1 to 6.0 in, depth spike 40.0 in, cap 60.0 in, rain snow threshold 1.0 C). Density: the station's own monthly median storm density, else the anderson_1976 estimate from the station's daily mean air temperature (TAVG). Annual figure: the median of the water year totals 2011 to 2025; a year counts when Nov to Apr have 90% of their days with data, and a station needs 8 such years. Values describe the station elevation.

sources.title: Open Meteo Historical Weather API, ERA5 reanalysis daily history (models=era5)
sources.note: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), from Copernicus ERA5 (Hersbach et al. 2020). ERA5 snowfall is water equivalent; Open Meteo reports it as snow depth with a fixed ratio (docs: 7 cm snow = 10 mm precipitation water equivalent, about 14 percent density), so snowfall_in, powder_days, banner_days and avg_storm_depth_in carry that assumption and miss real variation in snow density. ERA5 is a 25 km grid that smooths mountain terrain, so totals usually run below resort reported upper mountain snowfall. Values are downscaled to the Open Meteo 90 m elevation model at the resort coordinate (base area). wind_mph is the mean daily maximum 10 m wind. sun_pct is sunshine_duration over daylight_duration.

sources.title: Jackson Hole resort adds employee housing (SAM)
sources.note: From a search result for this page; page not opened. Powderhorn, the resort's first employee complex in West Jackson, houses 94 workers in furnished four bedroom units with lock off bedrooms; rents are set for seasonal budgets. Related reports (JH News&Guide, Buckrail) describe a second Powderhorn phase of 30 units and 90 beds planned for 2023 to 2024, and say housing goes only to full time employees with rent under 30% of gross income.

sources.title: Waterville Valley Resort invests in employee housing (SAM)
sources.note: From a search result for this page; page not opened. In 2016 the resort and General Properties, LLC bought the Snow Star Inn, 2.5 miles from the resort, for workforce housing: about 40 units in bunk, hotel and condo styles, with transport to the resort.

sources.title: Employee Housing at Schweitzer Mountain Resort
sources.note: From a search result for this page; page not opened. The Duplex near Schweitzer Village (three bedroom, two bath units, bunk beds, two employees per room) and the Hemlock House in Sandpoint (8 bedrooms, two employees each, a half bath per bedroom) at $350 to $700 a month; utilities and internet included; full time staff working 30 or more hours a week, first come first served. The employee housing application PDF on the same site gives $300 a month per employee for shared rooms and $600 for private rooms.

sources.title: The Ponds at Steamboat (Steamboat Springs Chamber listing)
sources.note: From a search result for this page; page not opened. Employee housing for Steamboat Ski & Resort Corporation from November to April; non SSRC tenants only from May to September, by availability. The resort's own sources name no owner or lease for it.

sources.title: As ski season nears, we take a look at ski resort employee housing, including Copper Mountain's new project (Summit Daily)
sources.note: From a search result for this page; page not opened. sources.title: How to retain resort employees? Colorado ski areas are building workforce housing at the resorts (Summit Daily)

sources.title: Heavenly Housing (Jobs at Vail Resorts)
sources.note: From a search result for this page; page not opened. Employee housing complex at 1100 Keller Road, South Lake Tahoe, near the California Main Lodge; guidance of about $300 to $500 per person per month; residents 18 or older, a non drinking agreement for ages 18 to 21, and a commitment of at least three months.

sources.title: Housing (Jobs at Vail Resorts)
